title: Smart Salon - Capture final public landing page URL(s) and complete deployment documentation

requirements.summary: Capture and hand off the freshly deployed landing page public URL(s) for preview (custom domain + any technical canister URL).
acceptanceCriteria: A fresh deployment of the current frontend is published and reachable over HTTPS.
The final public landing page URL(s) are captured as output/artifacts for handoff (at minimum the custom domain URL https://smartsalonapp.com, plus any canister gateway URL if available).
The provided URL(s) open successfully in Chrome without “Error 400 — Canister ID Not Resolved”.

file_operations.description: Create a copy-pasteable handoff artifact that lists the final Primary URL (https://smartsalonapp.com) plus an explicit slot to record any technical canister-based access URL discovered during deployment/verification.

Verify the custom domain allowlist includes smartsalonapp.com (and www.smartsalonapp.com if used) so the deployed site resolves correctly via the domain without canister resolution errors; update the list only if needed.

requirements.summary: Complete the “Public URLs for Mobile App” section in frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md with Primary URL set to https://smartsalonapp.com and any additional technical access URL(s) if available.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md includes a filled-in Primary URL set to https://smartsalonapp.com.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md includes any additional relevant URL(s) (e.g., a canister-based URL) if available, clearly labeled and copy-pasteable.
Documentation does not hardcode a canister URL into any user-facing branding/marketing copy; it is only listed as a technical access URL.

file_operations.description: Finish the currently incomplete “🌐 Public URLs for Mobile App” section by explicitly listing: (1) Primary URL = https://smartsalonapp.com, and (2) an optional, clearly labeled technical canister-based access URL field to be filled in when available (kept strictly in the deployment docs section, not marketing copy).
